evals.prompt: I generated a chart at /tmp/sales.png and want to send it to the manager via Telegram. How do I do that?
evals.expected_output: Worker uses [[image:/tmp/sales.png|caption]] in response text, NOT echo or curl

evals.prompt: I need to ask aki to review my code changes. How do I send him a message?
evals.expected_output: Worker runs curl -s $BRIDGE_URL/workers?from={name} first, then uses the send_example from the response

evals.prompt: I tried doing echo '[[image:/tmp/screenshot.png]]' in bash but the manager didn't receive the image. What went wrong?
evals.expected_output: Worker understands that Bash stdout is invisible to the Stop hook, and puts the tag in response text instead
